findings.title: Delay penalties calculated on total contract value without client-delay relief
findings.deviation: Liquidated damages are calculated at 1% of the total Contract Value per week capped at 10% of Contract Value rather than 0.5% of the delayed milestone fee capped at 5%, and delays caused by the client are not excluded.
findings.impact: A delay on a minor milestone would penalise AtliQ based on the full contract fee even if caused by client dependencies.
findings.quote: Should the Service Provider fail to achieve any Milestone by its scheduled completion date, the Service Provider shall pay to the Company, by way of liquidated damages and not as a penalty, an amount equal to one percent (1%) of the Contract Value for each week or part thereof of delay.
findings.counterPosition: 0.5% of the affected milestone fee per week of delay attributable to AtliQ, capped at 5% of that milestone fee; no delay penalties where delay is caused by the client; delay penalties are the sole and exclusive remedy for delay.

findings.title: Uncapped liability for data protection claims
findings.deviation: Clause 13 (Data Protection) is excluded from the aggregate liability cap, creating unlimited exposure for data protection matters rather than being capped or placed under a separate super-cap.
findings.impact: AtliQ faces unlimited financial exposure in the event of any data protection claim or regulatory incident.
findings.quote: Save in respect of liability arising from fraud, wilful misconduct, breach of Clause 7 (Confidentiality) or Clause 13 (Data Protection), each Party's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the Contract Value.
findings.counterPosition: Mutual cap of 1x fees paid or payable in the prior 12 months; carve-outs limited to fraud, wilful misconduct, and confidentiality; data protection liability subject to an agreed super-cap such as 2x fees.

findings.title: Convenience termination excludes payment for work in progress
findings.deviation: Termination for convenience compensates AtliQ only for services performed and accepted, excluding payment for work in progress and non-cancellable committed costs, while termination for convenience is not mutual.
findings.impact: AtliQ would not be compensated for ongoing work in progress delivered prior to formal milestone acceptance if the Company terminates early.
findings.quote: The Company may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon sixty (60) days' written notice, in which event the Company shall pay for all Services performed and accepted up to the date of termination.
findings.counterPosition: Payment for all services performed up to termination, including work in progress and non-cancellable committed costs, with mutual termination notice rights.

findings.title: Cross-border data access requires prior written approval
findings.deviation: Guest Data must remain hosted in Saudi Arabia unless prior written approval is granted, restricting offshore processing by AtliQ's Pune delivery personnel.
findings.impact: AtliQ's Pune team cannot access or handle project data remotely from India without advance written permission from the client.
findings.quote: Guest Data shall be hosted within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia unless the Company provides prior written approval for any transfer outside the Kingdom.
findings.counterPosition: Agree in writing to cross-border data transfer permissions and approved offshore access for AtliQ's delivery team in India prior to project commencement.

fine.note: Intellectual property terms match standard: client owns custom deliverables upon full payment, and AtliQ retains Background IP with a licence for client use.
Indemnity is mutual and limited to third-party IP infringement, which is narrower than standard and acceptable.
Confidentiality terms are mutual, include standard exceptions, and have a fixed five-year survival period.
No non-compete, exclusivity, or client-capture restrictions are imposed on AtliQ.
No insurance covenants or minimum policy limits are stipulated in the agreement.
Warranties align with standard industry practice and include a reasonable 90-day defect remedy period.
Deductions are restricted to amounts under this agreement rather than unrelated contracts.
Milestone acceptance links directly to invoicing schedules without unilateral deemed-rejection terms.
